description:
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Software Engineer to become an integral part of our global engineering team. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, working on strategic projects and delivering solutions as per our product roadmap. As a key member of our distributed development team, you will continuously improve our software development processes and play a vital role in our success.
 Work on greenfield and brownfield projects in Post Trade Technology, supporting various post-trade functions and Business as Usual requests.
 Propose improvements related to development and support activities, ensuring efficient and effective processes.
 Troubleshoot and resolve production system support issues, maintaining high system uptime and performance.
 Perform software maintenance and upgrades, keeping our systems up-to-date and secure.
 Liaise with different teams to resolve dependencies and ensure timely delivery of projects.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality solutions.
 Stay updated with the latest technologies and industry trends, continuously improving your skills.
 Document and communicate technical designs and decisions, ensuring clear and effective knowledge sharing.
 
 Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
 2-4 years of experience in software development, with a strong understanding of SDLC activities.
 Proficiency in Java, SQL Server, Postgres, Angular, Spring, and Docker is essential.
 Experience with Unix shell scripting, messaging technologies (Kafka, JMS, Solace), and Gitlab source control is required.
 Familiarity with CI/CD practices and DevOps methodologies is highly desirable.
 Knowledge of digital assets and technologies is an advantage, as is experience with Test-Driven or Behavior-Driven Development.
 Experience with cloud technologies, deployment, and design is a plus, as is PostgreSQL/Sybase experience.
 A background in Financial Services and an understanding of trade lifecycles is beneficial.
 Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for this role.
 A self-starter attitude, attention to detail, and a strong aptitude for learning new technologies are key attributes.
 Compensation Expectations: $110,000-$120,000 Base Salary
  
 #LI-JM3
